_meta.title: Kloel domain inventory — CONSOLIDATED machine digest
_meta.groundedIn: backend/prisma/schema.prisma + backend/src/** + worker/** (separate deployable). Every name is a real model/service/file verified by grep/AST. NO invented names.
_meta.note: Task brief said 16 files; only 7 inventory JSONs exist on disk (no '_'-prefixed inputs other than this output). All 7 were read in full. The 7 collectively cover every named vocabulary surface (Contact, Message, Conversation, Channel/Session, Workspace/Tenant, Product/Plan/Offer, Checkout/Order/Payment, Wallet/Ledger, Campaign, Memory, GlobalPrior).
criticCorrectionsApplied: 1. ChannelSession is FICTIONAL — confirmed ZERO grep matches in src/ and schema.prisma. Removed from canonical vocabulary. Real channel-session surface = WhatsappSessionService (backend/src/marketing/channels/whatsapp/whatsapp-session.service.ts:19) over ChannelSetup (schema:3492) + MetaConnection (schema:3467).
2. Lead is NOT an alias of Contact. KloelLead (RAC_KloelLead, schema:1834, separate live table) recorded as an explicit P1 MERGE DECISION vs Contact (RAC_Contact, schema:399), not a settled alias.

3. OpsEvent (schema:1614, written by OpsAlertService at observability/ops-alert.service.ts) and RiscEvent (schema:1273, written by ComplianceService.routeRiscEvent at compliance/compliance.service.ts:140) are LIVE models — added (were absent from v1).

4. campaign-jobs/voice-jobs/media-jobs are NOT dead — they have live workers in the separate worker/ package (worker/campaign-processor.ts:147 campaignWorker, worker/voice-processor.ts:254 voiceWorker, worker/media-processor.ts:16 mediaWorker, all `new Worker(...)`). Only mass-send (backend/src/mass-send/*) is genuinely the questionable one. Corrected.

5. In-flight migrations surfaced as mid-migration (not converged): KloelMemory->MindMemory dual-write (mind-memory-item.service.ts:96, flag KLOEL_MINDMEMORY_DUALWRITE default OFF), MindMessage canonical-but-dead-on-read (flag KLOEL_MINDMESSAGE_DUALWRITE), ProductPlan.price(Float)->CheckoutProductPlan.priceInCents.

6. (Bonus) identity-auth.json called RiscEvent an 'ingest-only stub with no processor' — STALE. ComplianceService.routeRiscEvent (compliance.service.ts:148/165) IS the processor and writes/updates riscEvent rows. Corrected in services/events.

duplications.concept: Sale/Order/Payment record split — one human payment can be PAID in one ledger and PENDING in another
implementations: CheckoutOrder (schema:3220) + CheckoutPayment (schema:3330) — checkout pipeline source of truth, CheckoutPaymentService.capture (checkout/checkout-payment.service.ts:52)
KloelSale (schema:1917) — chat-driven sales source of truth, SalesService (sales/sales.service.ts:64) + kloel/PaymentService + kloel/SmartPaymentService
Payment (schema:2744) — generic raw webhook-only record, NO owning @Injectable service
PhysicalOrder (schema:2706) — physical fulfillment, saleId String? with NO FK
duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutOrder+CheckoutPayment for product sales; KloelSale becomes a thin originator that ALWAYS materializes a CheckoutOrder; retire the orphan Payment model.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Make every KloelSale create/confirm also upsert a CheckoutOrder+CheckoutPayment keyed on a shared externalId. 2) Repoint webhooks/payment-webhook-stripe.handlers.ts:44-54 and payment-webhook-generic.helpers.ts:79/111 to a single resolver that updates ONE canonical row, not three parallel updateMany() calls. 3) Fold KloelSale revenue into admin gmv.query.ts and dashboard.service GMV. 4) Drop RAC_Payment after confirming zero readers besides webhook helpers.

duplications.concept: Phone normalization semantics diverge across Contact-keying paths (BR-promotion vs digits-only vs raw) → one human becomes multiple Contact rows
implementations: CheckoutSocialLeadService.buildContactUpsertArgs -> digitsOrNull (digits-only, NO 55 promotion), aliased locally AS `normalizePhone` checkout-social-lead.service.helpers.ts:185
duplications.canonicalChoice: normalizePhone() from backend/src/common/phone/phone-normalization.util.ts:150 (structured, BR-promoting). ALL Contact/KloelLead (workspaceId, phone) writes MUST route through it.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Replace digitsOrNull/raw-phone keying at every Contact and KloelLead write with normalizePhone().digits. 2) Normalize at the channel boundary BEFORE getOrCreateLead (fixes the WhatsApp coordinator raw-JID path). 3) Remove the misleading `import digitsOrNull as normalizePhone` alias in checkout-social-lead. 4) Backfill/merge already-fragmented Contact rows (needs the orphan merge service activated).

duplications.concept: processWhatsAppMessageWithPayment looks up KloelLead by RAW senderPhone while the lead was created under normalized phone → high-buy-intent payment link silently not generated (lost revenue)
implementations: KloelLeadProcessorService.processWhatsAppMessageWithPayment lookup prisma.kloelLead.findFirst({ where:{ workspaceId, phone: senderPhone } }) RAW (kloel-lead-processor.service.ts:285)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Use normalizePhone(senderPhone).digits for the lookup, matching getOrCreateLead.
duplications.migrationSketch: Single-line fix at kloel-lead-processor.service.ts:285 to normalize the lookup key; add a regression test asserting the payment link fires for a '(11) 98765-4321'-format sender.

duplications.concept: Plan / pricing source-of-truth split across two tables with different money units → merchant can edit a price that has NO commercial effect
implementations: CheckoutProductPlan (RAC_CheckoutProductPlan, schema:2969, priceInCents Int) — checkout/checkout-product.service.ts [canonical, ONLY model read by checkout-order-pricing.util.ts]

ProductPlan (RAC_ProductPlan, schema:2213, price Float; priceInCents Int nullable mid-migration) — plans/plan.service.ts + kloel/product-sub-resources/product-plan.controller.ts:83 + kloel-product-sub-resource-tools.service.ts:107
duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutProductPlan.priceInCents — the only plan model read by paid pricing. ProductPlan.price is never consulted at order time.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Backfill ProductPlan.priceInCents from price*100 for all rows (PHASE A is only additive on NEW PlanService.create writes; ProductPlanController + chat tools don't dual-write). 2) Route ProductPlanController and KloelProductSubResourceToolsService writes through CheckoutProductService. 3) Make order pricing the single reader (already is). 4) Demote ProductPlan to read-through view or retire.

duplications.concept: Coupon model + validation divergence (ProductCoupon vs CheckoutCoupon) — two value types, two enum spellings, divergent validate logic
implementations: CheckoutCoupon (RAC_CheckoutCoupon, schema:3178, Int cents, DiscountType PERCENTAGE/FIXED) + validateCouponHelper (checkout/checkout-catalog.helpers.ts:79) [canonical — only coupon priced at order time, enforces minOrderValue/appliesTo/discountAmount]

ProductCoupon (RAC_ProductCoupon, schema:2297, Float, PERCENT/FIXED) + kloel/CouponService + ProductCouponDomainService + ProductCouponController.validate (product-coupon.controller.ts:154) [omits minOrderValue/appliesTo/discount-amount]
duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutCoupon + validateCouponHelper. ProductCoupon becomes a write-through view that always upserts a CheckoutCoupon (or is retired).
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Make ProductCouponController.validate delegate to validateCouponHelper. 2) Make ProductCoupon writes always upsert CheckoutCoupon (sync already exists one-way). 3) Unify enum spelling (PERCENT/PERCENTAGE) at the model. 4) Eliminate the Float->cents rounding round-trip by storing cents on both.

duplications.concept: Cognitive loop (perceive->predict->belief->surprise->policy->update) implemented 3+ times with divergent storage; one persists NOTHING
implementations: MindPredictionService.runCycle (mind/mind-prediction.service.ts:51) -> in-memory activePredictions[] + RAC_AutopilotEvent (NON-durable, lost on restart, linear surprise=confidence)
duplications.canonicalChoice: MindService.tick + MindEventProcessorService — the only DB-persisted, lease-coordinated, prediction-table-backed loop.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Make MindPredictionService persist to RAC_MindPrediction (or delete its shadow loop) so learning isn't split across two unreconciled stores. 2) Unify surprise math on MindSurpriseService.computeSurprise (Shannon -log(p)) — remove the linear surprise=confidence path. 3) Re-scope mind-bg as an explicit 'substrate sub-tick' demoted under MindProcessorService.

duplications.concept: Access-token logout blacklist writes a Redis key namespace the JWT guard never reads → logged-out access token stays valid until natural expiry
implementations: AuthService.logout() -> redis.set('access-token-revoked:<jti>') (auth.service.ts:329) [DEAD: nothing reads this key]
duplications.canonicalChoice: AuthTokenService.revokeAccessToken (key `jti:revoked:<jti>`), the namespace JwtAuthGuard actually checks.
duplications.migrationSketch: Repoint AuthService.logout to call AuthTokenService.revokeAccessToken instead of the bespoke set; delete the dead `access-token-revoked:<jti>` write; add a test asserting a logged-out access JWT is rejected.

duplications.concept: Request -> workspaceId tenant resolver with DIVERGENT security semantics → cross-tenant IDOR risk
implementations: workspace-access.ts:119 resolveWorkspaceId (SECURE: enforces requested===token.workspaceId, Forbidden on mismatch) [canonical]
kloel/guards/kloel-security.guard.ts:45 getWorkspaceId (reads params/body, IGNORES the JWT)
kloel/product-sub-resources/helpers/common.helpers.ts:20 getWorkspaceId (req.user||req.workspaceId||'' — can yield empty string, no cross-check)
common/throttler/route-class.guard.ts:25 resolveWorkspaceId (trusts x-workspace-id header — throttle-keying only)
partnerships/partnerships.controller.ts:44 — ALREADY CONVERGED onto the secure resolver (proof team knows the others are unsafe)
duplications.canonicalChoice: workspace-access.ts resolveWorkspaceId — the only variant that proves the caller owns the workspace.
duplications.migrationSketch: Converge kloel-security.guard + common.helpers onto resolveWorkspaceId (follow the partnerships.controller migration pattern at line 45). Keep route-class.guard's header-trust ONLY for throttle keying, never for data access.

duplications.concept: Two parallel outbound dispatch registries: pure ChannelDispatchRegistry vs guarded ChannelTransportRegistry (two result contracts, flag-gated partial delegation)
implementations: ChannelDispatchRegistry (common/channel-dispatch/channel-dispatch.registry.ts:31) — keyed by ChannelKind, ChannelDispatchPort adapters, NO policy guard [canonical transport core]

ChannelTransportRegistry (kloel/channel-transport.registry.ts:52) — keyed by ChannelName, ChannelTransportProvider, MindGuard + audit, flag-gated delegation (KLOEL_TRANSPORT_CANONICAL_DELEGATE, default OFF, excludes email+tiktok)
duplications.canonicalChoice: ChannelDispatchRegistry as the transport/routing core; keep ChannelTransportRegistry ONLY as a guard+audit decorator that ALWAYS delegates.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Finish the KLOEL_TRANSPORT_CANONICAL_DELEGATE rollout (flip default ON) so the legacy provider.send() bodies in channel-transport.providers.ts become dead. 2) Resolve the email exclusion (EmailChannelTransport uses EmailCampaignService — a different mechanism than the email adapters; that mechanism split is itself a latent P1). 3) Collapse the two result contracts (see ChannelSendResult dup below).

duplications.concept: Per-channel send implemented twice: marketing/channels/*-dispatch.adapter vs kloel/channel-transport.providers
duplications.canonicalChoice: marketing/channels/*-dispatch.adapter (ChannelDispatchPort). TikTokDispatchAdapter's own docstring says it 'supersedes' TikTokChannelTransport.
duplications.migrationSketch: Collapse the *ChannelTransport classes into thin guard-only decorations once delegation is the only thing they add; resolve the EmailChannelTransport mechanism divergence first (it changes delivery behavior, hence its canDelegate exclusion at registry.ts:169).

duplications.concept: Two services send to the SAME Meta page endpoint ${pageId}/messages under two ChannelKinds (Messenger vs Facebook); only one persists
implementations: FacebookMessengerService.sendMessage (marketing/facebook-messenger.service.ts:41) — ChannelKind.FACEBOOK, persists FbMessage (RAC_FbMessage schema:3911) + full webhook processing
duplications.canonicalChoice: FacebookMessengerService is the richer, persistence-backed implementation; MessengerService is the thin duplicate. Make the ChannelKind split semantically real or unify to one page-messaging service.
duplications.migrationSketch: Route both kinds through one page-messaging service that always persists FbMessage (as a provider-native delivery ledger) while RAC_Message stays the canonical conversation store; verify whether FB inbound is double-persisted into both RAC_Message and RAC_FbMessage.

duplications.concept: Three Meta-connection readers with divergent shapes + ~19 raw prisma.metaConnection.find* bypasses
duplications.canonicalChoice: MetaWhatsAppService.resolveConnection as the single credential resolver; MetaConnectionStateService consumes it; delete resolveInstagramConnection.
duplications.migrationSketch: Unify token-expiry semantics (EXPIRED in meta-connection-state.service.ts:31 vs tokenExpired in resolveConnection) into one helper; replace raw find* callsites with the resolver.

duplications.concept: Lead family — Contact (RAC_Contact) vs KloelLead (RAC_KloelLead): two person/lead entities modeling the same human with overlapping funnel columns. MERGE DECISION (Lead is NOT an alias of Contact).
implementations: Contact (RAC_Contact, schema:399, unique workspaceId_phone) with leadStatus/leadStage/lastMessage/lastIntent/totalMessages mirror — read by CrmService/CRM UI

KloelLead (RAC_KloelLead, schema:1834, unique workspaceId_phone) with status/stage/lastMessage/lastIntent/totalMessages/score — read by LeadsService for GET /kloel/leads/:workspaceId (the leads-list UI), live backing store for the WhatsApp lead-processing path
ScrapedLead.phone (schema:779) — distinct identity surface until imported
duplications.canonicalChoice: Contact is the DECLARED canonical person (PERSON migration). This is an UNSETTLED merge: KloelLead funnel state is mirrored onto Contact via best-effort dual-write + backfill, but the cut-over is NOT complete and LeadsService still reads KloelLead. Treat Contact-vs-KloelLead as an open P1 merge decision, NOT a settled alias.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Make KloelLead funnel state read-through/derived from Contact. 2) Repoint LeadsService.listLeads from KloelLead to Contact (fix the stale frontend docstring at leads.ts:4-12 that already claims Contact-backing). 3) Activate ContactIdentityMergeService (currently orphan, zero callers) to reconcile already-fragmented rows. 4) Then retire RAC_KloelLead.

duplications.concept: Three near-identical lead-lifecycle services (WhatsApp message -> KloelLead + Contact dual-write), each with its own getOrCreateLead
duplications.canonicalChoice: LeadMindCoordinator (self-annotated canonical). Collapse the other two into it, or extract one shared getOrCreateLead + syncCanonicalContact helper.
duplications.migrationSketch: Extract a single getOrCreateLead(workspaceId, normalizedPhone) + syncCanonicalContact helper; delete the 3 drifted copies; normalize phone at the channel boundary before any of them.

duplications.concept: Two distinct WalletService classes with the SAME name on DIFFERENT tables (DI/import hazard)
implementations: kloel/wallet.service.ts:49 WalletService -> KloelWallet/KloelWalletLedger (seller earnings; confirmPayment pending->available, withdraw)
wallet/wallet.service.ts:73 WalletService -> PrepaidWallet/PrepaidWalletTransaction (usage credits; createTopupIntent, debit)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Rename to SellerWalletService and PrepaidWalletService (or UsageWalletService). Legitimately different domains; the identical class name is a maintenance + DI trap.
duplications.migrationSketch: Rename both classes + their provider tokens; update injectors. Both call MercadoPagoPixChargeService/StripeService so wrong-import bugs are silent today.

duplications.concept: Five parallel money balance+ledger systems with near-identical hand-rolled append/reconcile/mature logic and inconsistent ledger contracts
implementations: PrepaidWallet/PrepaidWalletTransaction (usage prepaid, self-ledger with balanceAfterCents) — wallet/WalletService
ConnectAccountBalance/ConnectLedgerEntry (Stripe Connect per-account, balanceAfter snapshots) — payments/ledger/LedgerService
WalletAnticipation (Float receivable anticipation, schema:2855) — NO dedicated service
duplications.canonicalChoice: Each represents a genuinely different actor's money — keep separate, but extract ONE shared append-only ledger abstraction (direction/bucket/amountInCents/balanceAfter/reason + reconcile + maturation).
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Define a SharedLedger interface; back the 4 ledger writers with it. 2) Add balanceAfter to KloelWalletLedger + MarketplaceTreasuryLedger (currently missing, unlike ConnectLedgerEntry/PrepaidWalletTransaction). 3) Migrate WalletAnticipation Float -> BigInt cents. 4) Unify the 3 reconciliation services (ConnectLedgerReconciliationService, MarketplaceTreasuryReconcileService, common/ledger-reconciliation.service.ts).

duplications.concept: Cart/abandonment recovery owned by two independent crons on different cadences with no cross-dedup (same human recovered twice)
implementations: kloel/CartRecoveryService — @Cron 30min over CheckoutOrder status=PENDING, MIND-chosen email, stamps CheckoutOrder.recoveryEmailSentAt

checkout/CheckoutSocialRecoveryService (checkout-social-recovery.service.ts:46) — @Cron 10min over CheckoutSocialLead, deterministic workspaceChannels gate, stamps CheckoutSocialLead.recoveryEmailSentAt/recoveryWhatsAppSentAt
duplications.canonicalChoice: One Recovery domain owning 'a buyer started but did not pay' regardless of whether they reached order-creation (CheckoutOrder PENDING) or only lead-capture (CheckoutSocialLead).
duplications.migrationSketch: Unify the two crons behind one recovery scheduler keyed on the person (Contact); dedup so a human who is both a PENDING CheckoutOrder and a CheckoutSocialLead is recovered once; pick one channel-decision engine (MIND bandit vs deterministic gate).

duplications.concept: Unified message table (RAC_MindMessage) vs the 4 live source tables it claims to canonicalize — canonical-but-DEAD-on-read
implementations: RAC_MindMessage (schema:3849) source discriminator brain|dashboard|lead_conversation|thread|channel [DECLARED canonical; WRITE-ONLY, ZERO readers]
RAC_KloelMessage (schema:1691) — brain, REAL read/write via MindMessageService
RAC_ChatMessage (schema:1899) — dashboard thread, REAL read/write via MindChatMessageService/KloelThreadService
RAC_KloelConversation (schema:1865) — lead funnel, REAL read/write via saveLeadMessage
RAC_Message (schema:721) — omnichannel, REAL read/write via InboxService.saveMessage
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_MindMessage is the DECLARED canonical but is canonical-but-DEAD: every writer is gated behind KLOEL_MINDMESSAGE_DUALWRITE (default OFF) and there are ZERO readers (StateBuilderService.resolveShortTermMemory + KloelConversationStore read .items = prisma.kloelMessage). Until backfill + read cut-over lands, the 4 legacy tables remain de-facto canonical per surface.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Wire ONE reader path (state-builder + conversation-store) onto RAC_MindMessage behind a read flag. 2) Backfill the 4 source tables into RAC_MindMessage. 3) Flip dual-write ON, verify parity, then cut reads over. 4) Until then, do NOT enable dual-write blindly (ON-but-no-reader = 2x write cost + silent divergence). Stale schema comment on MindMessage claiming 'ZERO writers' must be corrected.

duplications.concept: Conversation-history read implemented across 6 call sites with divergent take/order/projection — 'history' means different windows per caller
duplications.canonicalChoice: MindCanonicalService.getConversationHistory as the single read; the others are pre-facade reads the Mind unification was meant to absorb.
duplications.migrationSketch: Route all 6 callers through MindCanonicalService.getConversationHistory with an explicit window parameter; remove the bespoke take limits (20/30/50).

duplications.concept: MindMemory vs KloelMemory — canonical memory table dual-written but legacy remains source of truth (split-brain risk)
implementations: RAC_KloelMemory (schema:1711, @deprecated) via MindMemoryItemService.items — PRIMARY read+write, ~89+ direct prisma.kloelMemory callers
RAC_MindMemory (schema:3872) dual-write behind KLOEL_MINDMEMORY_DUALWRITE (mind-memory-item.service.ts:96) + read by kloel-memory-engine.service.ts:232/282/192
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_MindMemory (target) — but migration is incomplete; RAC_KloelMemory still authoritative.
duplications.migrationSketch: 1) Backfill RAC_KloelMemory -> RAC_MindMemory. 2) Repoint the ~89 prisma.kloelMemory callers through MindMemoryItemService. 3) Flip dual-write ON, verify, cut reads over to RAC_MindMemory fully. The schema comment on MindMemory claiming 'canonical-but-dead / ZERO writers' is STALE (2 writers, 2 readers exist) — correct it.

duplications.concept: Two parallel workspace-invitation models + services (workspace could show two different pending-invite lists for the same person)
implementations: CollaboratorInvite (schema:2768) + PartnershipsService.inviteCollaborator/revokeInvite (partnerships.service.ts:103-137) [status enum + invitedBy, NO email send, NO accept-creates-Agent path]
duplications.canonicalChoice: Pick ONE invite model. Invitation has the richer flow (email + accept->create-Agent); CollaboratorInvite has the better schema (status enum, invitedBy, indexes).
duplications.migrationSketch: Merge into one model+service: take Invitation's accept/email flow and CollaboratorInvite's schema columns; migrate rows; delete the loser.

duplications.concept: Entire admin auth stack duplicates the tenant auth stack with no shared core (security fixes don't propagate)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Extract a shared credential/MFA/session core; keep AdminUser vs Agent as the only divergence (principal table + RBAC granularity).
duplications.migrationSketch: Hoist password hashing, TOTP, session rotation, login throttling, audit append into common/; both stacks consume them. The access-token-revocation bug (P0) is a live example of a fix that didn't propagate.

duplications.concept: TOTP engine + MFA implemented identically in two services
implementations: AdminMfaService same functions, same constants MFA_PERIOD_SECONDS=30 / MFA_WINDOW_STEPS=2 (admin/auth/admin-mfa.service.ts:20-96)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Hoist one TOTP util (common/totp.ts); both MFA services import it. Secret encryption is ALREADY shared (admin-crypto), so only the HOTP/codec math needs extraction.
duplications.migrationSketch: Move base32Encode/base32Decode/generateTotp/verifyTotp to common/totp.ts; both services import; delete the copies.

duplications.concept: Inconsistent token-at-rest policy across token families (plaintext bearer tokens in DB)
implementations: ApiKey.key — PBKDF2 HASHED but column documented as plaintext 'sk_live_...' (schema:1649)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Standardize: store sha256(token) for all bearer tokens (matches AdminSession/MagicLink); query by hash. Keep PBKDF2 only for the API-key secret if a lookup index is added.
duplications.migrationSketch: Hash RefreshToken + PasswordResetToken at rest; query by hash; migrate existing rows on next rotation. A DB read leak currently exposes live tenant refresh + reset tokens in plaintext.

duplications.concept: ApiKey validation is an O(n) full-table scan running PBKDF2 per candidate (DoS amplifier)
implementations: ApiKeysService.validateKey -> findMany(take:1000) then linear verifyStoredKey (PBKDF2 210k iters) over every row (api-keys.service.ts:122)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Store a deterministic lookup hash (sha256 of the raw key) in an indexed column for the WHERE clause; keep PBKDF2 only for the constant-time secret compare.
duplications.migrationSketch: Add indexed lookupHash column; backfill from existing keys on rotation; change validateKey to WHERE lookupHash = sha256(rawKey) then single PBKDF2 verify.

duplications.concept: Three+ parallel product/plan CRUD write stacks; the checkout stack bypasses events/audit/cognition
implementations: ProductService + PlanService (products/, plans/) [ProductService alone emits mind.product.observed + AuditService + MindEventSpine]
duplications.canonicalChoice: Consolidate Product writes on ProductService (it alone emits events+audit+brainSpine); plan writes on CheckoutProductService (canonical money).
duplications.migrationSketch: Route CheckoutProductService.createProduct through ProductService for the Product half; route sub-resource controllers + chat tools through the service layer; products created via checkout are currently invisible to cognition/audit.

duplications.concept: Order bump / upsell stored both typed and as JSON; JSON variant not read by checkout pricing
implementations: OrderBump (schema:3132) + Upsell (schema:3154) typed tables via CheckoutCatalogService (checkout-catalog.service.ts:30,117) [priced at checkout]
ProductPlan.checkoutImages.orderBump JSON via PlanService.setOrderBump (plan.service.ts:419) [dead config, never read by pricing]
duplications.canonicalChoice: Typed OrderBump/Upsell tables.
duplications.migrationSketch: Stop writing the checkoutImages JSON slots; migrate any data into typed rows; merchant edits via PlanService.setOrderBump currently never surface on the actual checkout.

duplications.concept: Affiliate config has 3-5 sources of truth with no synchronization
implementations: AffiliatePartner (workspace partners) + ProductCommission (per-product splits, schema:2332) — 4th/5th overlapping commission surface
duplications.canonicalChoice: Product.affiliate* columns (what AffiliateService.getConfig reads).
duplications.migrationSketch: Make AffiliateProduct + ProductPlan affiliate fields derive from / sync to Product.affiliate* columns; define one commission source of truth.

duplications.concept: Member enrollment created by divergent paths; auto-enroll on payment emits no event and is invisible to cognition
implementations: CheckoutPostPaymentEffectsService.autoEnrollInMemberAreas (checkout-post-payment-effects.service.ts:228) [inlines stats update, emits NOTHING, re-keys buyer by email with no link to CheckoutOrder]
duplications.canonicalChoice: MemberEnrollmentsController path (event + shared stats service).
duplications.migrationSketch: Make autoEnrollInMemberAreas call MemberAreaStatsService.recalculate + emit member.enrolled; link enrollment to CheckoutOrder.customerEmail instead of re-keying by email.

duplications.concept: Divergent surprise / prediction-error math (same concept 'surprise', different units)
duplications.canonicalChoice: MindSurpriseService.computeSurprise (information-theoretic, used by belief update + causal model).
duplications.migrationSketch: Make MindPredictionService use MindSurpriseService.computeSurprise; downstream thresholds (e.g. self-modification surprise>0.7) are currently ambiguous depending on which loop fired.

duplications.concept: Two BullMQ tick schedulers fanning out the same active-workspace set (5s vs 30s)
duplications.canonicalChoice: MindProcessorService for the persisted cognitive tick; demote mind-bg to a clearly-scoped substrate sub-tick or fold in.
duplications.migrationSketch: Make one scheduler own 'who ticks a workspace'; nest the substrate cadence under it to avoid double work + Redis queue sprawl.

duplications.concept: Event spine has TWO physical event sinks; generic events land in the legacy non-idempotent table
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_MindOutboxEvent (transactional, idempotent, dispatchable) as the single spine sink.
duplications.migrationSketch: Migrate generic brain/cognition events onto the outbox; note MindPerceptionService READS percepts back out of RAC_AutopilotEvent, so the perception read path must move too.

duplications.concept: Two webhook controllers named MetaWebhookController with duplicated HMAC-verify + Redis-NX + WebhookEvent dedup
duplications.canonicalChoice: Extract the shared HMAC-verify + Redis-NX + WebhookEvent-dedup into one guard/util; keep two thin route handlers; rename one class to remove the same-name collision in meta.module.ts.
duplications.migrationSketch: Unify the verify-token env precedence (META_MARKETING_VERIFY_TOKEN||META_VERIFY_TOKEN||META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN vs META_VERIFY_TOKEN); copy-on-security-path is exactly the drift class to eliminate.

duplications.concept: ChannelCapability + ChannelSendResult DTOs declared twice (blocked required vs optional)
duplications.canonicalChoice: common/channel-dispatch/channel-dispatch.port.ts DTOs. Re-export the transport variants as type aliases (ChannelName already does this for the name union).
duplications.migrationSketch: Delete the transport-side re-declarations; alias them; remove mapCanonicalResult/mapResult glue at channel-transport.registry.ts:283 and whatsapp-dispatch.adapter.ts:80.

duplications.concept: Channel-name vocabularies: ChannelKind (lowercase) vs OmniChannel (Uppercase) vs ChannelIdentifier casing
duplications.canonicalChoice: ChannelKind (lowercase) as the one enum; OmniChannel and identifier casing become derived Uppercase<ChannelKind> views.
duplications.migrationSketch: ChannelName was already collapsed to a derived view of CanonicalChannelName (good precedent at channel-transport.types.ts:22); do the same for OmniChannel and the contacts-layer casing.

duplications.concept: Legacy ProductCheckout (JSON-blob) vs canonical CheckoutProductPlan/CheckoutConfig graph
implementations: ProductCheckout (schema:2273) — single row, 14-section JSON config blob; consumed by kloel chat tools (kloel-product-sub-resource-tools.service.ts) + product-checkout.controller.ts
CheckoutProductPlan + CheckoutConfig + CheckoutPlanLink (schema:2969/3027/3005) — typed-column canonical graph
